answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to post a refundable stake that is slashed on proven fraud, while trusted peers vouch with a signed quill of attestation. A lone sparrow may join cheaply, but building real reputation takes sustained, verifiable work, so an attacker faces a spiral of rising cost: every fake identity must fund its own stake, pass peer review, and wait out a cooling period before it can earn. Cheap copies cannot shortcut the queue, and honest work stays profitable.
